- [Web3 dApp development](https://mohsinalisolangi.me/services/web3-dapp-development/): wallet-connected React applications, contract integration, APIs, indexers, and product interfaces.
- [DeFi and token development](https://mohsinalisolangi.me/services/defi-token-development/): staking, presales, ICO and IDO systems, swaps, rewards, token utility, and decentralized finance workflows.
- [Solana development](https://mohsinalisolangi.me/services/solana-development/): Rust and Anchor programs, SPL token workflows, and wallet-connected Solana applications.
- Web3 solution architecture: discovery, scope, permissions, contract architecture, data flows, integrations, and launch planning.
- Security-minded engineering: trust boundaries, permissions, key management, testing, and common vulnerability patterns. Independent formal audits are recommended for high-value production protocols.
